description: FR-INJ-04. Bounds for the optional second-opinion classifier. Enabling it is an environment decision (LLM_ADJUDICATOR_ENABLED=true) because it sends payload text to whatever adapter an operator registered; this file only bounds when and for how long.

band.basis: The warn band. Below 40 the rules found nothing worth a second opinion, and at 70 the pipeline already escalates on its own — asking a model to confirm a decision that is being made anyway spends latency and disclosure for no change in outcome.
